title: UI Push Preview
description: Computed: what a push of the source branch into the target branch would write there, and the conflicts it would hit, as the requesting user may read them. Read-only; nothing is written.

target.description: The branch pushed into: ?target=, else the source's parent.

changes.description: Each write of the push into the target, in the order it is made. before and after are left out of a write on an item the user may not read (in the target, or in the source).

key.description: The item's key: its name, and a stylesheet's applies_to.

before.description: The target's row the write updates or deletes; for a create, the item the target shows beneath it (its parent's or a packaged layer's); null for none.

after.description: The row as the push writes it; null for a delete.

conflicts.description: The conflicts of the source against the target on items the user may read there, as a refused push (409) lists them.

unreadable_conflicts.description: How many other conflicts there are, on items the user may not read.
